lines.say: a long-acting copy of GHRH, the brain signal that releases growth hormone
growth hormone rose for days after one injection in healthy adults (small studies)
IGF-1 rose about 40% a week after one injection in healthy adults (small study)
heart rate rose in a second study
higher blood sugar assumed, from the label of tesamorelin, which works the same way
injection-site reactions in about 70% after one injection
flushing, headache, dizziness and low blood pressure after repeat injections
one death from a heart attack in a halted trial, with causality not established
animal studies found DNA damage in pituitary cells; no cancer studies exist
fluid retention is a label warning for tesamorelin, which works the same way

ask: Given my heart health, blood pressure and blood sugar, is a long-acting growth hormone booster safe for me?
